newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly up on demand.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly up on demand.

text.p: Millfeed prices were mostly steady to higher on Tuesday, supported by a pickup in nearby demand in several locations across the United States, dealers said.
"We are seeing a lack of flour mill run times that is keeping the Buffalo market firm," a Buffalo dealer said.
Another dealer said that nearby demand was getting stronger in the Midwest due to shorter run times.
In Minneapolis, demand for spot feed was steady. "That is making March better," a broker said.

But another dealer said he understood the spurt in demand was for just this week. He noted market talk that some rail cars were having difficulty getting to their points of destination, "so they have to fill in with trucks," he said.
"I think the pickup in nearby demand seems to be in the Texas Panhandle and eastern Texas," he said.
One Carolinas dealer said the market was also firm in the South. "It is the same story. There is not enough flour mill run time to take care of everything," he said.
